summary: Docs, domain model and both operate playbooks describe the new model; commands.md already equals gendocs output. The gate cannot pass on this machine because its section() helper does not work with the system awk.
verified: vloop task gate T13 exited 1: 'docs/domain/domain-model.md has no M-4'; a temp copy of the gate with the awk regex escapes doubled printed 'gate T13: ok'.
notes: operate skill is 1602 words (ceiling 1750). The gate's section() passes '^- \*\*M-4\*\*' through awk -v, which processes escapes; macOS awk (20200816) turns it into a regex that matches nothing, so M-4 and M-6 sections are always empty. Needs '\\*' in the gate (or a non-awk extraction).

gate_dispute.reason: The gate's section() helper passes regexes with \* through awk -v, where the escape is consumed; under BSD awk the pattern matches nothing, so the M-4 section is always empty regardless of content.
gate_dispute.evidence: printf -- '- **M-4** x\n' | awk -v s='^- \*\*M-4\*\*' '$0 ~ s' prints nothing, while s='^- \\*\\*M-4\\*\\*' matches; the gate fails with 'docs/domain/domain-model.md has no M-4' although the line exists. With the escapes doubled in a temp copy the gate prints 'gate T13: ok'.
